cohort: 1675 elderly parturients who underwent repeated cesarean delivery between May 2011 and March 2020
finding: The number of cesarean deliveries, placental attachment, placental previa, and placental implantation are independent risk factors for primary postpartum hemorrhage in elderly parturients undergoing repeated cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study investigated primary postpartum hemorrhage in elderly parturients undergoing repeated cesarean delivery (PHEPWRCD), identifying the number of previous cesarean deliveries as an independent risk factor for PHEPWRCD.
